# The alternate screen (47, 1047, 1049) and the saved cursor (DECSC,
# DECRC, SCOSC, SCORC, 1048).

=== 47 switches to the alternate screen without moving the cursor
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_ALTBUF
input: abc\r\nabc\e[?47h\e[2J\e[2;1Hdef\r\ndef
cursor: 3,4
screen:
|..........|
|def.......|
|def.......|
|..........|
|..........|

=== Leaving 47 shows the main screen again
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_ALTBUF
input: abc\r\nabc\e[?47h\e[2J\e[2;1Hdef\r\ndef\e[?47l
cursor: 3,4
screen:
|abc.......|
|abc.......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== Returning to 47 finds the alternate screen as it was left
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_ALTBUF
input: abc\r\nabc\e[?47h\e[2J\e[2;1Hdef\r\ndef\e[?47l\e[?47h
screen:
|..........|
|def.......|
|def.......|
|..........|
|..........|

=== Leaving 1047 clears the alternate screen
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_OPT_ALTBUF
input: abc\r\nabc\e[?1047h\e[2J\e[2;1Hdef\r\ndef\e[?1047l\e[?1047h
screen:
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== 1049 saves the cursor on entry and restores it on leaving
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_OPT_ALTBUF_CURSOR
input: abc\r\nabc\e[?1049h\e[5;5Hx\e[?1049l
cursor: 2,4
screen:
|abc.......|
|abc.......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== 1049 clears the alternate screen on entry
source: esctest2 decset.py test_DECSET_OPT_ALTBUF_CURSOR
input: \e[?1049hX\e[?1049l\e[?1049h
screen:
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== The alternate screen keeps no scrollback
source: xterm (the alternate screen has no saved lines)
scrollback: 10
input: a\r\nb\e[?1049h\e[5;1H\n\n\n\e[?1049l
history: 0
screen:
|a.........|
|b.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DECRC restores the position DECSC saved
source: esctest2 decrc.py (SaveRestoreCursor_Basic with ESC 7 and ESC 8)
input: \e[4;5H\e7\e[H\e8
cursor: 4,5

=== SCORC restores the position SCOSC saved
source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_Basic (CSI s, CSI u)
input: \e[4;5H\e[s\e[H\e[u
cursor: 4,5

=== DECRC with nothing saved homes the cursor
source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_MoveToHomeWhenNotSaved
input: \e[3;3H\e8
cursor: 1,1

=== DECRC restores the pen
source: xterm ctlseqs DECSC (saves character attributes)
input: \e[1m\e7\e[m\e8A
style: 1,1 bold

=== DECRC restores origin mode
source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_ResetsOriginMode
input: \e[3;3H\e7\e[2;4r\e[?6h\e8\e[1;1HX
screen:
|X.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DECRC restores the character sets
source: xterm ctlseqs DECSC (saves the character set state)
input: \e(0\e7\e(B\e8q
screen:
|─.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DECRC restores a pending wrap
source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_Wrap; DEC STD 070
input: 0123456789\e7\e[H\e8X
cursor: 2,2

=== DECRC leaves IRM alone
source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_InsertNotAffected
input: \e[4h\e7\e[4l\e8\e[1;1Ha\e[1;1Hb
screen:
|b.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== DECRC leaves DECAWM alone
source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_Wrap (xterm)
input: \e7\e[?7l\e8\e[1;9Habcd
cursor: 1,10
screen:
|........ad|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== The main screen keeps its own saved cursor
source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_AltVsMain
input: \e[2;3H\e7\e[?47h\e[4;5H\e7\e[?47l\e8
cursor: 2,3

=== The alternate screen keeps its own saved cursor
source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_AltVsMain
input: \e[2;3H\e7\e[?47h\e[4;5H\e7\e[?47l\e8\e[?47h\e8
cursor: 4,5

=== 1048 saves and restores the cursor
source: xterm ctlseqs DECSET 1048
input: \e[2;3H\e[?1048h\e[H\e[?1048l
cursor: 2,3

=== DECRQM reports the alternate screen
source: xterm ctlseqs DECRQM
input: \e[?1049$p\e[?1049h\e[?1049$p\e[?47$p
replies: \e[?1049;2$y\e[?1049;1$y\e[?47;1$y
